title: Chapter 598 - 598 Killer; Strange Mangroves!
content:
Chapter 598 - 598 Killer; Strange Mangroves!

Chapter 598 - 598 Killer; Strange Mangroves!

598 Killer; Strange Mangroves!

The entire forest was dead silent!

At the same time, several emotionless voices rang out in the forest.

[Augustus, the chosen one, has died. Nashland’s desert area has increased by 50%.]

[First to kill a level-five King Kong. You’ve obtained a level-five treasure chest.]

[First to kill a level-five King Kong. Hua Nation’s mines have increased by 50%.]

…

In Nashland’s live broadcast room.

The host looked at the live broadcast with his mouth half open. He was completely stunned.

The death of Augustus was simply too tragic.

After a long while, the host let out a sound of disbelief.

“Oh… Augustus is dead…”

As the host’s voice fell, bullet comments finally appeared in the silent live broadcast room.

Neil: [No! This is not true!]

Colombus: [How could Augustus die?!]

Morris: [Fake! This is fake!

Clint: [Heavens! Suddenly, a wisp of black gas was emitted from the Void Gate above the city. Then, the entire city turned into a desert!]

Austin: [Desert… It’s true. Augustus is really dead.]

Francois: [That Lin Fan could have saved Augustus, but he didn’t do anything. He’s a murderer! A detestable murderer!]

Davidson: [Yes! Murderer!]

Hubert: [We must punish Lin Fan severely.]

Jax: [Punish the murderer Lin Fan!]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing was also shocked by Augustus’s miserable state.

However, she was soon happy because Hua Nation’s mines had increased by 50%.

“Thank you, Professor Lin.” Xiao Bing said. “You killed another ferocious beast and increased Hua Nation’s mines by 50%! Thank you!”

Sorrow: [God Lin is awesome!]

Shadowless: [Awesome sword skill! In anime, there’s a One-Punch Man. Any enemy would be killed with a single punch. God Lin is One-Sword Superman. No matter how powerful a ferocious beast was, it’ll be killed with a single sword move!]

Attempting to Redeem: [God Lin is so awesome!]

Unrivaled World: [The mines in our country has increased by 50%. In the future, our country is destined to become more and more powerful!]

Flower in the Wind: [The people from Nashland seem to be saying that they’ll punish God Lin severely. They even said that God Lin is a murderer.]

Ryoko Redaka: [Murderer? Punish? Pah!]

Motoboy: [What do they mean God Lin didn’t save him? Putting aside the fact that God Lin wouldn’t be able to save him in time, even if God Lin did save him, Augustus would probably say, “Who told you to save me? I was just playing with the King Kong, like a cat playing with a mouse.]

Han: [If you ask me, Augustus deserved it!]

New: [God Lin did the right thing!]

Feng Family: [Murderer? Did God Lin kill him? What a joke!]

I Like You Every Day: [There are more and more people scolding God Lin in Nashland’s live broadcast room. Is there anyone who wants to go there and scold them back with me?]

321: [Yes!]

Hong Tian: [Count me in!]

Nothing Is Difficult in the World: [Me too.]

…

Naturally, Lin Fan did not know that such a small matter had caused a huge war.

Of course, even if he knew, he would not care too much.

He immediately focused his attention on the level-five treasure chest and casually opened it.

[You’ve obtained Beginner Lightning Control Technique. Do you want to use it?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—Advanced Lightning Control Technique.]

Lin Fan’s body went numb.

Then, he felt that his power could be easily converted into lightning.

No!

It was not just power that could be converted into lightning.

He even had a very strange feeling. It was as if as long as he willed it, endless divine lightning could descend from the nine heavens!

It was extremely strange.

Lin Fan experienced this special feeling, and his lips curled up. Clearly, he was in a good mood.

He looked at Sam, who was still lying on the ground.

Then, his gaze landed on the Heavenly Hound. He said, “Heavenly Hound, take this Beginner Lightning Control Technique.”

When the Heavenly Hound heard this, it slowly stepped forward and placed its paw on the ball of light.

Instantly, the Heavenly Hound’s eyes seemed to flash with lightning, and they became even more stern.

…

In the blink of an eye, five days had passed.

In these five days, Lin Fan did not encounter any more ferocious beasts.

However, he had relied on his time in the Otherworld to obtain a total of 600 Constitution points and 800 spiritual energy. He had become even stronger.

Today, Lin Fan, the dog, and Sam were still walking in the wilderness.

In the live broadcast room, Xiao Bing would occasionally explain the environment of the Otherworld.

The audience in the live broadcast room was as large as usual.

From time to time, they would let out a wave of yearning toward the Otherworld and praise Lin Fan.

However, very soon, there were some different discussions.

Flowers Bloom: [Have you heard? Nashland, Eagle Country, Japes, Bear Country, Jia Country… Many heroes from different countries suddenly lost their way and lost their strength when they entered a mangrove forest. Then, something terrible happened.]

Asians: [Something scary? I’ll go to the external website to take a look.

One in Ten Thousand: [It’s indeed terrifying! There were many human-faced monsters in the mangrove forest. They liked eating the flesh of the heroes alive.]

Lover: [What?!]

Asians: [Ugh! It’s so terrifying! I just went to the internet to take a look… I probably won’t be able to eat lunch.]

Youth Won’t Come: [After these heroes died, the air quality in many countries declined and pollution increased…]

Ai Debi: [Why are there such terrifying creatures in the Ptherworld?]

Send You Away: [The mangrove forest you mentioned… Could it be the one in front?]

123 Wooden Man: [What? God Lin is about to go there? Don’t go! That forest is very strange!]

…

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Yuxuan, Hu Tian, and the others were all watching the live broadcast attentively.

At the same time, they also learned about the situation in the mangroves.

The women could only pray silently, “Lin Fan, please be fine.”

…

At this moment, Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam were still moving forward.

Sam ate a piece of leftover bird leg meat from last night and said with satisfaction, “How delicious!”

Just as he threw away the bone, he found a mangrove forest not far away. He said in surprise, “Master, there’s a mangrove forest over there. Are those maple leaves? I don’t think so. Moreover, it doesn’t seem to be autumn now.

“Red leaves? Or flowers?”

“But they’re so beautiful!” Sam scratched his head. “It would be great if we could have a few beauties beside us. We’d definitely be able to have a wonderful night.”

At this point, Sam seemed to have already imagined that scene, and his face was full of yearning.

“Master, are we going to the mangroves?” Sam asked.

Lin Fan said, “Since we’re passing by, let’s go take a look.””

At this moment, the Heavenly Hound, which rarely barked, suddenly roared toward the sky.
